label: Historical Wardrobe
description: Period costume with era-accurate construction. Tagged 'historical' for genre coupling.

items.name: victorian-gown
items.text: a high-collared 1880s Victorian gown, boned bodice closed with jet buttons, draped overskirt gathered into a bustle

items.name: victorian-gentleman
items.text: a Victorian frock coat over a brocade waistcoat, silk cravat pinned at the throat, pocket watch on an albert chain

items.name: medieval-kirtle
items.text: a front-laced medieval wool kirtle over a linen chemise, fitted through the torso, skirt falling in deep gathered folds

items.name: medieval-doublet
items.text: a padded medieval doublet, pewter buttons and lacing points at the waist, sword belt slung across the hip

items.name: twenties-flapper
items.text: a 1920s drop-waist flapper dress, tiers of beaded fringe, marabou feather headband over finger-waved hair

items.name: twenties-suit
items.text: a 1920s three-piece pinstripe suit, high-waisted trousers on braces, fedora brim snapped low

items.name: regency-empire
items.text: a Regency empire-waist gown of sheer white muslin, short puffed sleeves, long kidskin gloves

items.name: fifties-swing
items.text: a 1950s polka-dot swing dress, cinched patent belt, full circle skirt floating on crinoline petticoats

items.name: pirate-coat
items.text: a weathered age-of-sail captain's justacorps, deep turned-back cuffs, tarnished brass buttons and a leather baldric

items.name: edwardian-lace
items.text: an Edwardian high-neck blouse of pin-tucked cotton lace, leg-of-mutton sleeves, long walking skirt over an S-bend silhouette

items.name: renaissance-gown
items.text: an Italian Renaissance gown of crimson velvet and gold brocade, square neckline, pearl-strung sleeves tied on with points

items.name: sixties-mod
items.text: a 1960s mod shift minidress in color-block wool, white go-go boots, geometric drop earrings

items.name: rococo-court-gown
items.text: a 1750s robe à la française, sack-back pleats falling from the shoulders, skirts spread wide over panniers, ruched silk trim and a stomacher laced with bows

items.name: seventies-disco
items.text: a 1970s halter jumpsuit in liquid gold lamé, plunging neckline, wide flared legs over platform sandals, stacks of thin bangles

items.name: greek-chiton
items.text: an ancient Greek chiton of fine pleated linen, pinned at the shoulders with bronze fibulae, girdled twice at the waist, a himation draped over one arm
